defects.description: Detector flagged knees_to_one_side (legs symmetric) but description explicitly says hips stay squared forward — symmetric legs are CORRECT, not a defect.
Detector flagged reclining (globalTilt missing) but description says Sit back on the heels in a kneeling base — kneeling, NOT lying down.

Description says Sit back on the heels in a kneeling base. Baseline has hip 80° + knee 100° (chair-sit posture with knees up), NOT a kneeling base. Should have less hip flexion (thigh more vertical) and deeper knee flexion (shin folded back).
Description says planting one hand on the floor behind you for support. Baseline has shoulderFwdL:+7 (slight backward) and elbow 65° (bent) — wrist at z=+0.087 (forward of body), not planted behind.

Description says twist the ribcage to one side. Renderer has no per-torso axial-twist joint — only globalTwist (whole-body Y rotation) which would also rotate the hips, contradicting hips stay squared forward. Renderer limitation; cannot fix via pose-data patch.

failing_tests.assertion: legs should be in kneeling posture (hip flexion < 60°, knee flexion > 130°)
one wrist should be BEHIND body (z <= -0.05) for planted support hand
ribcage axial rotation should be non-zero
failing_tests.actual: torso_axial=0 (renderer does not model per-torso twist)

regression_risk: medium — substantial leg geometry change (4 fields); verified no anomalies/plausibility flags but visual confirmation needed
rationale: Both detector flags are FALSE POSITIVES: knees_to_one_side is wrong (description says hips squared forward, symmetric legs correct) and reclining is wrong (sit-back-on-heels is kneeling, not lying). Real defects: (1) not kneeling base — hip 80°/knee 100° is chair-sit; reducing hip to 40° (thigh more vertical) and deepening knee to 150° (shin folded back) brings posture closer to kneeling. Renderer cannot lower hips to floor (hips pinned at y=0.12), so true sit-back-on-heels is unachievable, but leg geometry is more kneeling-like (knee y drops from +0.279 to -0.279). (2) Hand not planted behind — shoulderFwdL:7→30 (backward, positive shoulderFwdL moves wrist behind when shoulder in default abduction, verified empirically), leftElbow:65→15 (almost straight, forearm extends down to floor). Verified: leftWrist.z=-0.138 (behind body). (3) Ribcage twist is renderer-limited (no per-torso twist joint; globalTwist would rotate hips too).
